Independent and hostile checks, partial Lean algebra if useful, one gate-level synthesis note only; no physical promotion on internal algebra PASS.

Operationally prepared state and the reservoir coherence/phase information it actually preserves
Measurement operator/response and calibration for both norm charges and the invariant conversion quadrature
